title: 637301 Report layout override lifecycle
summary: Report layout overrides for extension-installed layouts now write Tenant Report Layout Override records with lifecycle properties (status, description, obsolescence) scoped per field and per company, preserving existing company-level overrides while offering copy as an escape hatch.
key_points: Status and Edit info changes on extension-installed layouts now write a Tenant Report Layout Override record instead of copying the layout
Overrides apply to all companies by default; the former confirmation prompt is removed
A company that already has its own status override keeps further status changes in that company; mixed-scope batch runs are rejected
Scope is resolved per field, and only fields the user actually changed are written
Save Changes to a Copy remains as an opt-in path; user-defined layouts are still updated in place
